dedup.key: from + to + content + 60 s window (MAILBOX_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS = MAILBOX_DELIVERY_LEASE_MS)

interjection.ttl: expireInterjections() flips pending -> expired once now >= expiresAt (silence = DENY)
